title_placeholder: Leave empty to use the first line of the text
photos_empty: No diary entries with photos yet

admin.title: Diary settings
admin.description: Categories, weather, display modes and texts of diary-type boards.
admin.cats_help: Drag a row or use ▲▼ to reorder. Counts are those of the list panel (secret entries included; the default also holds entries without a category and those of deleted categories).
admin.default_help: Default category: entries written without a category are saved with this one.
admin.delete_default_tip: The default category cannot be deleted. Make another one the default first.
admin.delete_last_tip: The only category cannot be deleted.
admin.fix_rows: Fill in the emoji, name and colour of every row to save.
admin.fix_chips: Every weather needs an emoji and a name to save.
admin.weather_help: Drag a chip or use ◀ ▶ to reorder. Renaming or a new emoji keeps the weather of saved entries.
admin.weather_none: With no weather the write form hides the weather row.
admin.list_mode_hint: Pages show page numbers; infinite scroll loads more as you scroll down.
admin.list_size_hint: Leave empty to use the board's list size. 1–100.
admin.photo_mode_hint: The photo gallery uses one of the same two modes.
admin.title_length_hint: An empty title is cut from the first line of the text (5–100 characters, default 30).
admin.photo_title_hint: Auto title of an entry with photos but no text. Default "(사진 일기)".
admin.memories_empty: Text when there are too few memories
admin.memories_empty_hint: Shown in the empty places when On this day cannot find enough entries.
admin.memories_order_text: This day in past years → the same month in past years → at random.
admin.memories_order_more: Today is the site time zone's date. Past years start with the nearest one; on 28 February of a common year a past 29 February also counts. Secret entries the viewer cannot open, blinded and deleted entries are never picked. On PC "Pick again" leaves out what is shown; on mobile one entry opens at once and is left out next time. Missing places get the text above.
admin.direct_emoji_hint: Paste one emoji and press Apply.
admin.direct_hex_hint: # and six hex digits (e.g. #22C55E), then Apply.
admin.leave_text: If you leave now, the changes on this tab are lost.
admin.delete_cat_text: {{count}} entries of this category will show the default category ({{base}}).
admin.delete_weather_text: {{count}} entries with the weather "{{name}}" will show no weather.
admin.delete_note: Entries are not changed. Press the tab's Save to apply.

err.color_hex: Colours are # and six hex digits.
err.range_list: A number from 1 to 100, or empty.
